spring.trend_summary: Green‑space has been marginally lower in 2024 (≈50.5 %) compared to 2016 (≈50.9 %), while non‑green land grew slightly. Average temperatures in spring have edged down by ~0.8 °C over the same period.
recommendations: Implement rain‑water harvesting and green roofs in suburban areas to increase green cover and reduce heat‑island effects.
Use reflective or light‑colored pavement in high‑traffic zones to offset the slight temperature rise.

summer.trend_summary: Summer green‑space rose from ~52 % (2017) to ~56 % (2024). Non‑green land fell by ~4 %, and summer temperatures climbed by roughly 4 °C, showing a clear warming trend during the hottest part of the year.
recommendations: Prioritize tree planting along major road corridors to increase shade and lower ambient temperatures.
Introduce urban green corridors that link existing parks to encourage ecological continuity and cooler micro‑climates.

autumn.trend_summary: Green cover in autumn grew from ~47 % (2016) to ~55 % (2024), while non‑green land fell. Autumn temperatures have risen slightly, suggesting that the higher green cover is not yet offsetting the overall warming trend.
recommendations: Adopt mixed‑species planting in parks to improve carbon sequestration and cooling capacity.
Upgrade existing landscaping with drought‑resistant native species to maintain green cover during cooler seasons.

winter.trend_summary: Winter green‑space dropped from ~57 % (2016) to ~47 % (2024) and non‑green land grew. Winter temperatures fell by ~1.6 °C, indicating that the loss of green space may have contributed to a modest cooling during winter months.
recommendations: Plant winter‑green shrubs and perennials that retain foliage to sustain green cover throughout the year.
Enhance insulation and thermal performance of buildings to reduce heat loss to the environment.

average.trend_summary: Overall green‑space remained relatively stable (51.6 % in 2016 to 52.0 % in 2024), while non‑green land declined slightly. Average temperatures rose by ~2.4 °C, indicating a general warming trend across all seasons.
recommendations: Integrate green infrastructure city‑wide, including parks, green roofs, and street trees, to counteract the rising average temperatures.
Develop a city‑wide monitoring program using high‑resolution satellite data to track land‑cover changes and temperature fluctuations in real time.
Increase tree cover through afforestation and reforestation programs.
Implement sustainable agricultural practices to enhance soil carbon sequestration.
Protect and restore wetlands and natural grasslands for carbon storage.
Promote urban forestry and green roofs to enhance urban carbon sequestration.
